report.tagline: India's biggest beauty shopping app and store chain, selling genuine makeup, skincare and fashion online and in 338 stores.
report.simpleSummary: Nykaa is where Indian women, and more and more men, buy lipstick, sunscreen, shampoo and perfume online. It buys most beauty products straight from brands and keeps them in its own warehouses, so buyers trust they are not fake. It also runs over 300 physical stores, a fashion app, and its own brands like Kay Beauty and Nykaa Cosmetics. It makes money from the margin on what it sells, ads that brands pay for, and its own high-margin brands.

overview.whatItDoes: Nykaa sells beauty, personal care and fashion products through its apps, website and stores. For beauty, it mostly buys stock from brands and sells it itself, which lets it promise the products are genuine. It also builds its own brands and runs Superstore, an app that supplies beauty products to small shops.
howItWorks: Brands sell products to Nykaa. Nykaa stores them in its warehouses and ships them to buyers. This is called an inventory model.
Buyers discover products through tutorials, reviews and Nykaa's own content, then buy in the app.
Nykaa Fashion runs as a marketplace where brands list and Nykaa takes a commission.
Stores like Nykaa Luxe and Nykaa On Trend let buyers try before they buy, and push them to the app later.
Nykaa Now delivers beauty in 30 to 60 minutes in 15 cities.
Superstore by Nykaa sells stock to over 5.5 lakh small retailers and chemists.
overview.valueProposition: Genuine products, the widest beauty range in India, and help in choosing through reviews, videos and expert advice.

painPoints.howSolved: Thousands of brands across price levels, from ₹99 lip balms to luxury perfumes.

painPoints.pain: Not knowing which product suits you.

businessModel.summary: In beauty, Nykaa buys products and sells them at a markup. In fashion it takes a commission as a marketplace. On top of both it earns money from brand ads and from its own brands, which have the highest margins.

revenueStreams.detail: Margin on products Nykaa buys from brands and sells online and in stores. Biggest share of revenue.
Cut of each sale on Nykaa Fashion. Fashion revenue was ₹287 crore in Q2 FY27, up 43%.
Brands pay for banners, search placement and campaigns on the app.
House of Nykaa brands sold on Nykaa and other platforms, at a ₹4,000 crore yearly GMV run rate.
Selling stock to small retailers, ₹1,187 crore GMV in FY26.

businessModel.pricing: Free to use. Products are sold at or below MRP, with regular discounts. Free delivery above a minimum order value, otherwise a small delivery fee. Prive membership is earned through spending.
costDrivers: Cost of products bought from brands
Marketing, creators and discounts during sales
businessModel.unitEconomics: Take a ₹1,800 beauty order. Nykaa might keep around ₹750 after paying the brand, because beauty margins plus ads are high. Out of that, about ₹150 to ₹200 goes on delivery and packing, ₹100 to ₹150 on marketing and discounts, and some on warehouse and payment costs. That leaves a small profit per order. The rough numbers line up with the company: profit is small (₹204 crore on ₹10,022 crore revenue in FY26), but it is growing because own brands and ads carry better margins.

growth.moat: Over 13 years, Nykaa has built trust that its products are real, close ties with thousands of brands, and India's biggest beauty store chain. A new player would need years to match the brand range, the reviews and the store footprint.

competitors.name: Tira (Reliance Retail)

competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Nykaa has a bigger range, more reviews and a longer trust record. Tira can spend heavily on discounts.

competitors.name: Purplle
competitors.positioning: Value beauty for smaller cities, with strong own brands.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Nykaa is stronger in premium and luxury. Purplle is cheaper and closer to Tier-2 buyers.

competitors.name: Amazon and Myntra beauty
competitors.positioning: Beauty inside big general shopping apps.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Nykaa is a beauty specialist with better content and authenticity trust.

competitors.name: Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart
competitors.positioning: Beauty and personal care in 10 minutes.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Quick commerce has fewer items. Nykaa Now is Nykaa's answer with a wider range.

northStar.why: Beauty is a habit. A person who keeps coming back to Nykaa every month trusts the products and finds what suits them. It captures both trust and discovery, which are Nykaa's core value.

pmLessons: Trust can be a product feature. Nykaa chose to own stock so it could promise genuine products, even though it cost more cash.
Content helps people decide. In beauty, explaining what to buy matters as much as low price.
Online and offline can help each other. Stores bring new buyers, and the app keeps them.
Own brands can lift margins, but a PM must balance them against the partner brands that fill the shelf.

interviewQuestions.question: Why did Nykaa choose to hold inventory for beauty instead of being a pure marketplace?
interviewQuestions.hint: Talk about trust in genuine products, control over delivery and higher margin. Then cover the cost: cash tied up and risk of unsold stock.

interviewQuestions.question: Blinkit sells lipstick in 10 minutes. How should Nykaa respond?
interviewQuestions.hint: Split purchases into urgent refills and planned discovery. Defend urgent ones with Nykaa Now in key cities, and win discovery with range, content and expert help.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you increase repeat purchases on Nykaa?
interviewQuestions.hint: Look at reasons for not returning, use reorder reminders, Prive benefits and personalised home pages, and measure 60-day repeat rate.

interviewQuestions.question: Should Nykaa push its own brands harder on the home page?
interviewQuestions.hint: Weigh higher margin against user trust and brand partner relations. Suggest testing with clear labels and guardrails on partner brand sales.

interviewQuestions.question: Design a feature to help a first-time buyer choose a sunscreen.
interviewQuestions.hint: Define the user, list key questions (skin type, budget, finish), propose a short quiz with reviews and video, and measure conversion and returns.
